# Sustainable Jungle

> > Sustainable Jungle is a comprehensive resource for eco-conscious living, featuring sustainable beauty, fashion, home, and lifestyle product guides alongside educational content on ethical consumerism.

Founded by Amber McDaniel and featuring contributions from writers like Hailey Carrillo, Joy McConnochie, Francesca Brooking, and Shelby Loeppky, Sustainable Jungle helps consumers discover ethical brands and make environmentally responsible purchasing decisions. The site also produces The Sustainable Jungle Podcast and maintains a Substack newsletter for deeper engagement with the sustainability community.

## Key Topics
